description: Displays modal content above the page.

attributes.name: backdrop
attributes.description: Displays a backdrop behind the modal.

attributes.name: breakout
attributes.description: Allows the modal to ignore the default containment constraints.

attributes.name: fixed
attributes.description: Positions the modal relative to the viewport.

attributes.name: margin
attributes.description: Margin used when the modal is contained by the viewport.

attributes.name: outside-click
attributes.description: Closes the modal when the user clicks outside it.

events.name: tp-modal-toggle
events.description: Emitted when the modal open state changes.
events.detail: { backdrop: boolean; open: boolean; outsideClick: boolean; breakout: boolean; fixed: boolean }

cssproperties.name: --tp-modal-margin

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-modal>` element implements the <tp-icon name="modal" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Modal functionality: displays modal content above the page.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Activate the page's trigger to open the panel. |
| Using the component | Use its controls or links, then close it with the available dismissal control. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves to the next focusable control and wraps inside the modal. |
| Shift+Tab | Moves to the previous focusable control and wraps inside the modal. |
| Escape | Closes the modal. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
